quotes.text: Bug 1897051 ports an upstream file-handling change: disallowed characters in generated attachment filenames now map to underscores in the tested cases. Both Save and Open paths assert the same resulting leaf names, while Open also checks its temporary file. The upstream bug involved Windows filename filtering; this Thunderbird patch only changed test expectations. D210598 was accepted without inline change requests. Keep these tests aligned with the current shared filename sanitizer; do not infer a Thunderbird implementation change from this test-only patch.
